strings.name: Priyanka Chopra Jonas
strings.summary: Chopra Jonas moved from pageants into Indian film, developing roles in Fashion and Mary Kom before American television and international productions including Quantico and Citadel. She also produces and serves as a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, connecting cross-cultural visibility with advocacy for girls’ education and children’s rights.
